custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'structural_collapse' artifact at the base of the balusters. If the AI has simply blended the metal into the wood/carpet, this is a significant structural hallucination. Also, verify if the window grid lines remain straight and consistent behind the curved balusters, as warping here would indicate depth map errors.
